decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of permission 2011/0185 (dated 17/08/2025).
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - Details of the materials proposed to be used on all external surfaces of the development shall be carried out in accordance with the permitted approval of details application, ref: 2011/5066 dated 10/01/12.
Reason: In the interest of the appearance of the development and to safeguard visual amenity, in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 3 - Details of arrangements for the storage of refuse shall be carried out in accordance with the permitted approval of details application, ref: 2011/5012 dated 10/01/12.
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made for refuse and recycling storage in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - Details of a scheme to insulate the approved development against noise shall be carried out in accordance with the permitted approval of details application, ref: 2012/1242 dated 25/05/12.
Reason: To protect the occupiers of the building, in accordance with Council policies LP2 and LP14.
Condition : 5 - Details of facilities for people with disabilities, shall be carried out in accordance with the permitted approval of details application, ref: 2011/5067 dated 10/01/12.
Reason: To ensure that disabled people can satisfactorily use the building, in accordance with Council policy LP1 
Condition : 6 - Details of landscaping and treatment of parts of the site not covered by buildings shall be carried out in accordance with the permitted approval of details application, ref: 2011/5014 dated 10/01/12.
Reason: To ensure that disabled people can satisfactorily use the building, in accordance with Council policy LP1 
Condition : 7 - Archaeological site investigations shall be carried out in accordance with the detailed scheme submitted as part of the permitted approval of details application, ref: 2011/4523 dated 12/12/11. 
Reason: In order that the archaeological remains that may exist on the site can be investigated, in accordance with Council policy LP3
Condition : 8 - The east facing wall to the first floor level corridor from Block A through to Block B shall be glazed with obscured glass and maintained in obscured glass in the future, unless approved otherwise by the local planning authority in writing.
Reason: To control overlooking, and safeguard the privacy of neighbours in accordance with Council policy LP2
Condition : 9 - The screening between the roof terraces on the main roof of Building A, shown on the approved drawing, shall be completed before any use of the terrace commences, and retained permanently afterwards. 
Reason: To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking in accordance with Council policy LP2
Condition : 10 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved drawings and specifications, as amended in the section 73 application ref: 2011/5304 and 2011/5303 dated 31/01/12.
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.
Condition : 11 - The parking areas shown on the approved plans shall be provided before the occupation of any part of the development, and shall be retained for parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose. 
Reason: To ensure adequate arrangements are made for off-street parking in accordance with Council policies LP49 and LP50
Condition : 12 - The commercial unit shall be used for purposes within Class A1, A2 and B1 uses and for no other purpose without prior written consent from the local planning authority
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause loss of amenity do not commence without prior approval.
Condition : 13 - The retail premises shall not be open to customers other than between the hours of 0600hrs and 2130 hrs and at no other times. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policies LP2 and LP14 of the Wandsworth Local Plan.
Condition : 14 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, or any future enactment of that Order, no windows, doors or glazed areas (other than such as may be shown on the approved plans and which were permitted as part of the approval of details application ref: 2011/5302, dated 31/01/12 shall be formed in the walls of the building without the prior written consent of the local planning authority. 
Reason: To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking, in accordance with Council policy LP1 and LP2
Condition : 15 - The green roofs shown on the approved drawings shall not be used as amenity space. 
Reason: In order to ensure a sustainable development and to protect privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking in accordance with Council Policies LP1 and LP2 
Condition : 16 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, or any future re-enactment of that Order, no satellite dishes, telecommunications masts or equipment or associated structures, shall be installed on the building without the prior written approval of the local planning authority, other than those shown on the approved drawings (1329_2010 Rev. 14, 1329_2011 Rev. 13, 1329_2012 Rev. 12, 1329_2021 Rev. 12, 1329_2022 Rev. 11, 1329 1105 Rev. 05 1329 2004 Rev. 06).
Reason: To protect the appearance of the building, and accord with Council policies LP1 and LP2
Condition : 17 - No water tanks, plant, lift rooms or other structures shall be erected upon the roof(s) of the approved building(s) other than those permitted in the approval of details application, ref: 2012/5465 dated 03/01/13.without the written approval of the local planning authority. 
Reason: To control the appearance of the building and safeguard the appearance of the area, in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP2
Condition : 18 - The cycle storage provision shown on the approved drawings shall be provided before the occupation of the building and shall be retained permanently thereafter for users of the development and no other purpose.
Reason: To ensure that adequate arrangements are made for cycle storage in accordance with Council Polciies LP49 and LP50
Condition : 19 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved sustainable development/renewable energy report dated June 2010 and thereafter maintained, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.
Reason: To ensure that the scheme is consistent with Policy LP10.
Condition : 20 - The residential units within the development hereby approved shall be built to a minimum standard of Code for Sustainable Homes Level 4.A copy of the Post Construction Certificate verifying the Code for Sustainable Homes Level 4 has been achieved for the residential component of the development shall be submitted to the local planning authority within 3 months of occupation of the approved building. 
Condition : 21 - The commercial development hereby approved shall be built to a minimum standard of BREEAM 'very good'. A copy of the Post Construction Certificate verifying appropriate compliance shall be submitted to the local planning authority within 3 months of occupation of the approved building. 
Reason: To ensure a sustainable development in accordance with Council Policy LP10
Condition : 22 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the drainage strategy approved under application 2011/5563 (dated 28/12/11), including details of any off-site drainage works. No discharge of foul or surface water into the public system shall take place other than in accordance with the approved strategy. The approved measures shall be retained in perpetuity. 
Condition : 23 - The development permitted by this planning permission shall only be carried out in accordance with the Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) and accompanying drainage strategy, Revision A, dated 7 April 2011, prepared by Barnard and Associates, and the following mitigation measures detailed within the FRA: Limiting the surface water discharge to sewer to 51/s for the site as a whole unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. 
Reason: To prevent flooding by ensuring the satisfactory storage of/disposal of surface water from the site.

Condition : 24 - The components of a scheme to deal with risks associated with contamination of the site shall be carried out in accordance with the permitted approval of details application, ref: 2011/5015 dated 10/01/12. There is no known contamination in this area, however this is a brownfield site and it is on the Kempton Park Gravels, a secondary aquifer. Therefore there is potential for risk of contamination to groundwater.
Condition : 25 - The Green Travel Plan shall be implemented and permanently retained in the future unless the local planning authority gives written approval to its variation.
Reason: To ensure satisfactory provision is made to encourage the use of alternative means of travel instead of the private car, including greater use of public transport, cycling and walking in accordance with Policies LP49 and LP50. 
Condition : 26 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the delivery and servicing plan approved under application 2013/0781 (dated 27/02/13), including measures to protect the amenity of neighbouring residents. The approved arrangements shall be retained in perpetuity.  
Condition : 27 - The development shall be constructed in accordance with the method statement indicating what steps will be taken should protected species be found as permitted in the approval of details application 2011/4257 (dated 24/11/11). 
Condition : 28 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
